post.description: Starts an MCP session and negotiates the protocol version and capabilities. Returns the session ID in the `mcp-session-id` response header; send it back on all subsequent requests. This is a typed convenience endpoint for the `initialize` JSON-RPC method; standard MCP clients may also post the raw envelope to `/_mcp`. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

requestBody.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 request for `initialize`. The `method` is implied by the path.

protocolVersion.description: MCP protocol version the client supports, e.g. `2025-03-26`.

200.description: JSON-RPC response carrying the initialize result.

capabilities.description: Capabilities the server supports (tools, resources, prompts, logging, ...).

instructions.description: Usage instructions for the client / model.

post.description: Lists the tools available in the current sales-channel context, including each tool's `inputSchema`. Typed convenience endpoint for the `tools/list` JSON-RPC method. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

200.description: JSON-RPC response carrying the tools/list result.

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema describing the tool arguments.

post.description: Invokes a tool by name with arguments matching its `inputSchema`. Typed convenience endpoint for the `tools/call` JSON-RPC method. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

name.description: Name of the tool to invoke, as returned by `tools/list`.

200.description: JSON-RPC response carrying the tools/call result.

structuredContent.description: Structured tool output matching the tool's declared output schema.

isError.description: True when the tool execution failed; error details are in `content`.

post.description: Lists the resources available in the current sales-channel context. Typed convenience endpoint for the `resources/list` JSON-RPC method. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

200.description: JSON-RPC response carrying the resources/list result.

post.description: Reads the contents of a resource by URI. Typed convenience endpoint for the `resources/read` JSON-RPC method. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

uri.description: URI of the resource to read, as returned by `resources/list`.

200.description: JSON-RPC response carrying the resources/read result.

items.description: Resource content with either `text` or base64 `blob`.

post.description: Lists the resource templates (parameterized URIs such as `shopware://tool-result/{id}`) available in the current sales-channel context. Distinct from `resources/list`, which returns concrete resources. Typed convenience endpoint for the `resources/templates/list` JSON-RPC method. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

200.description: JSON-RPC response carrying the resources/templates/list result.

uriTemplate.description: RFC 6570 URI template with at least one placeholder, e.g. `shopware://tool-result/{id}`.

post.description: Lists the prompts available in the current sales-channel context. Typed convenience endpoint for the `prompts/list` JSON-RPC method. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

200.description: JSON-RPC response carrying the prompts/list result.

post.description: Returns the messages for a prompt by name, with arguments interpolated. Typed convenience endpoint for the `prompts/get` JSON-RPC method. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

name.description: Name of the prompt, as returned by `prompts/list`.

200.description: JSON-RPC response carrying the prompts/get result.

post.description: Liveness check. Returns an empty result. Typed convenience endpoint for the `ping` JSON-RPC method. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

200.description: JSON-RPC response carrying an empty ping result.

post.description: Raw JSON-RPC 2.0 entry point used by standard MCP clients over the Streamable HTTP transport. The `method` is supplied in the request body. For typed, per-method request and response schemas use the `/_mcp/{method}` endpoints (e.g. `/_mcp/tools/call`). Supports batch requests and notifications, which the per-method endpoints do not. Streaming responses are delivered as a `text/event-stream` body on this POST operation. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

requestBody.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 request object (or an array of them for batch requests). Omit `id` for notifications (no response expected).

200.description: JSON-RPC response or Server-Sent Events stream. Contains either a `result` (success) or an `error` (failure), never both.

schema.description: Server-Sent Events stream. Each `message` event carries a JSON-RPC response object as defined for `application/json`.

202.description: Notification accepted. Returned with an empty body for JSON-RPC notifications (requests without an `id`).

delete.description: Terminates the active MCP session identified by the `mcp-session-id` header. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

parameters.name: mcp-session-id
parameters.description: Session ID of the session to close. Obtained from the `mcp-session-id` response header of the `initialize` request.

options.description: Handles CORS preflight requests for the Store API MCP endpoint. Answered before routing; the response carries the `Access-Control-Allow-*` headers including `mcp-session-id` and `mcp-protocol-version`. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

McpSessionIdHeader.name: mcp-session-id
McpSessionIdHeader.description: Session ID returned by the server in the `mcp-session-id` response header after a successful `initialize` request. Required for all subsequent requests within the same session.

McpContextTokenHeader.name: sw-context-token
McpContextTokenHeader.description: Standard Store API context token identifying the customer session. When provided, MCP tools operate in the context of that customer.

McpSessionId.description: Session ID assigned by the server. Returned on the `initialize` response and echoed on subsequent responses. Send it as a request header on all following requests.

McpJsonRpcId.description: JSON-RPC request identifier echoed back on the response. Omit on requests for notifications (fire-and-forget).

McpNullableJsonRpcId.description: JSON-RPC response identifier. `null` when the request could not be parsed.

McpPaginatedRequestParams.description: Optional pagination parameters for list methods.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as `nextCursor` by a previous list result.

McpNextCursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page, absent on the last page.

McpContentBlock.description: Content block. `type` is one of `text` (with `text`), `image`/`audio` (with base64 `data` and `mimeType`) or `resource` (with embedded `resource`).

McpImplementationInfo.description: Name and version of an MCP client or server implementation.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code, e.g. -32700 parse error, -32600 invalid request, -32601 method not found, -32602 invalid params, -32603 internal error.
